definitions.explanation: The length of a garment measured from top to bottom, such as the length of a skirt, sleeve, or trousers. By extension, a person's height or the full extent of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丈|たけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{詰|つ}めて→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the trousers shortened a little.

examples.japanese: ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丈|たけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{長|なが}すぎた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{直|なお}して→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The sleeve length was too long, so I had it altered at the shop.

notes:
Most commonly refers to the length of clothing (skirts, sleeves, trousers). Also refers to a person's height or, in set phrases, the full extent of something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丈|たけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ / ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧: to be long / short (in length)
- {丈|たけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to shorten (a hem)
- ⟦{背丈|せたけ}→背丈：16140_setake⟧: one's height; stature
- {思|おも}いの{丈|たけ}: the full extent of one's feelings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧: length — general measurement of length; {丈|たけ} specifically suits clothing and height
- ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧: height (of a person) — the technical term for a person's height
